internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root surfaces overwhelmingly as one noun, sulṭān (37 of 39), plus a causative verb sallaṭa/yusalliṭu (2). Two large usages recur: a warrant/mandate that authorizes a claim or mission (usually 'clear', 'sent down', or 'brought' — e.g. Moses given a sulṭān mubīn; no sulṭān sent down for idols) and an authority/hold over persons (Satan disclaiming or scoping his sulṭān; God setting parties over one another). The Quran itself joins these two directions at 4:91, 4:144, and 17:33, where the warrant-marker mubīn/right sits on an over-persons sulṭān — so they read as two applications of one 'granted power-to-prevail', not two unrelated homonyms. But the account is not adversarially clean: 55:33 uses sulṭān as bare enabling means, and 69:29 as a possessed dominion that simply perished, neither of which reduces cleanly to warrant-or-authority-over. Hence a supported but capped, representative judgment.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT the sign/miracle itself (coordinated WITH āyāt: 11:96, 23:45, 40:23 — bi-āyātinā wa-sulṭānin mubīn); NOT knowledge (listed as a separate lack beside ʿilm: 22:71 mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānan wa-mā laysa lahum bihī ʿilm); NOT raw coercive force or mere suasion (14:22 — Satan had no sulṭān 'except that I called you', placing invitation OUTSIDE sulṭān); NOT intrinsic/permanent possession (69:29 — the one possessed sulṭān 'perishes'); NOT an office/monarchy ('ruler' sense absent). Object-side boundary: those reliant on God are structurally immune to being under a sulṭān (15:42, 16:99, 17:65), which grips only followers/allies (16:100).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 55:33 (yā-maʿshara l-jinni wa-l-insi ... lā tanfudhūna illā bi-sulṭānin): here sulṭān is sheer enabling means/capacity to penetrate the cosmic regions, with no adversary to dominate and no claim to warrant; it fits only the most abstract 'authorization' and thins the distinctive granted-relational-legitimating profile to raw capability, exposing the risk that a single unifying gloss ('authority') becomes a vague abstraction that fits everything.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Homonymy / two unbridged lexicalized classes: sulṭān-1 = authorizing proof/warrant (takes anzala, mubīn/bayyin, never compels persons) versus sulṭān-2 + the verb sallaṭa = power/dominance over persons (ʿalā-framed, never about a claim). The distributional seam is real: mubīn/bayyin attaches ONLY to the warrant set and the two Nisāʾ bridges, NEVER to the Satan hold-cluster, to 69:29, or to the protective/means uses. This competitor is rejected as a FULL split only because 4:91, 4:144, and 17:33 interpenetrate the two frames (mubīn/right on an over-persons sulṭān), but its strength is exactly why the grade is capped below STRONG.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: a single nucleus (conferred, legitimating power-to-prevail) is broad, distinctive in its granted-not-intrinsic feature, and Quran-internally bridged at 4:91/4:144/17:33; the negative boundaries (≠ āyah, ≠ ʿilm, ≠ intrinsic force, ≠ office) are clean and distinctive. STRONG/UNIVERSAL is withheld because (1) the root is effectively one heavily formulaic nominal lexeme (fixed frames sulṭān mubīn ~13x and mā anzala ... min sulṭān ~7x), so much of the regularity is lexical rather than the root actively distinguishing; (2) there is a materially resistant residue — 55:33 (bare means) and 69:29 (possessed dominion that perishes) — that no narrow gloss covers without retreating to a vacuous abstraction; (3) unity depends on a thin bridge (three verses) across a genuine distributional seam. Per the contract, a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class plus material resistance caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

Denied for shirk and idol-names; given with the signs to messengers (esp. Moses).

clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Largest and most formulaic set (23 occ); realizes the 'authorizing ground FOR a claim' pole of the nucleus. 22:71 internally separates it from ʿilm.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Sanctioned HOLD/authority OVER persons — ʿalā + persons, characteristically under negation (Satan/misleaders disclaiming a hold) or explicitly scoped ('only over those who ally with him', 16:100). Not compulsion: 14:22 reduces it to an accepted call ('except that I called you').
clusters.classification_rationale: Shared syntactic frame ʿalā + persons; the 'power' is derivative and conditional, gripping only followers, and immune over the God-reliant (15:42, 16:99, 17:65). Instantiates the 'authority OVER persons' pole.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Coherent cluster (7 occ) that keeps the over-persons pole near 'authorizing/accepted hold', not brute force; supports the granted-not-intrinsic feature.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The internal HINGE: a sulṭān that is simultaneously a clear WARRANT and a standing/right OVER-or-AGAINST persons — 4:91 (a clear sulṭān over the treacherous), 4:144 (a clear sulṭān against yourselves), 17:33 (the slain man's heir given warranted standing to seek redress).
clusters.classification_rationale: Uniquely combines the warrant-marker mubīn (C1's signature) with the ʿalā/li-persons frame (C2's signature); 17:33 grants a right-and-authority-over at once. These verses are the Quran-internal bridge licensing one nucleus rather than two homonyms.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Decisive for unity; without these three the split account would prevail. Their scarcity (3 occ) is also why unity is only REPRESENTATIVE, not established.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative sallaṭa/yusalliṭu 'set/cause-to-have-mastery OVER persons' — 4:90 (God would have set them over you so they would fight you), 59:6 (God gives His messengers mastery over whom He wills). Agent = God; the being-set-over is conferred, the martial force carried by a separate verb (qātala).
clusters.classification_rationale: Only Form II occurrences (2); frame X + ʿalā + persons. Verb-empowerment pairs semantically with the noun of conferred authority-over, confirming one granted-power notion across forms.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Cross-form support for the 'conferred authority OVER persons' pole; 4:90's result clause fixes actual prevailing/dominance (adversarial edge noted).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Granted EMPOWERING authority to prevail/protect — 17:80 (prayer for sulṭān naṣīr, a supporting empowering authority), 28:35 (protective empowering authority so adversaries cannot reach Moses and Aaron).
clusters.classification_rationale: Conferred by jaʿal 'from Us', relational to prevailing/protection; fits the granted-power-to-prevail nucleus without a claim-complement, sitting between the warrant and over-persons poles.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Small (2 occ) but coherent; reinforces the granted-not-intrinsic feature.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Residue that resists the nucleus: 55:33 = sheer enabling means/capacity (no adversary, no claim); 69:29 = a possessed personal dominion that simply perished (backs no claim, licenses no specified action-over).
clusters.classification_rationale: Neither takes mubīn, neither is sent-down-as-proof, neither backs a proposition nor is a scoped hold over persons. They lean on raw 'power/means/dominion' and only fit if 'authority' is stretched to vacuity — the contract's forbidden vague abstraction.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Material resistance that caps strength; both flagged as hard cases (RESISTANT_SEAM).
counterevidence: 55:33 (lā tanfudhūna illā bi-sulṭānin) uses sulṭān as sheer enabling means/capacity to penetrate the cosmic regions, with no adversary to dominate and no claim to warrant; it fits only the most abstract 'authorization' and thins the distinctive granted-relational-legitimating profile to raw capability.

69:29 (halaka ʿannī sulṭāniyah) is a possessed personal dominion that simply perished; it backs no claim and licenses no specified action-over, so it does not reduce to the warrant sense nor to the scoped authority-over-persons frame.

reconciliation.rationale: The salvage requires retreating to an abstraction ('authorization') broad enough to fit anything; with no adversary and no claim the distinctive granted-relational-legitimating profile is absent, so honesty requires marking it resistant rather than forcing fit.

It is possessed personal dominion that simply perished, backing no claim and exercised over no scoped persons; it reads as concrete might/dominion the warrant-and-authority nucleus does not predict, so it is a genuine resistant seam within the dominant noun class.

The verb sallaṭa supplies only the being-set-over; the fighting is carried by the separate verb qātala. Agent is God and frame is X + ʿalā + persons, matching 59:6, so it belongs to the conferred-authority-over pole.

adversarial_verification.notes: A full adversarial falsification returning SUPPORTED with an empty failing set is NOT achievable because 55:33 and 69:29 genuinely resist; the core nucleus nevertheless holds across the majority and is internally bridged. Per contract, resistance-with-holding-core is recorded as NOT_RUN, not PASSED or FAILED.
